# Read by build.py (checks), map-fork.py (writes the <fork/> sources) and review.py (sheets). Names are Adwaita file names without -symbolic.svg.
# The glyph column is `custom: ..` or `ForkName weight [scale=.. dx=.. dy=.. mirror=.. align=..]`. The weight is `bold` (1.5 px outline) or `fill`,
# the look of the icons as released in 5d49113; `regular` (1 px) is not used. `scale` is one factor on both axes (only Bluetooth uses it) and
# `dx`/`dy` a translation; build.py adds the half pixel shift that leaves the fewest soft edges. Nothing is ever warped (docs/bingux-ui.md).

# Icons that are flipped left to right when the interface reads right to left, because what they draw has a direction in the reading order: a
# chevron or arrow that points forward or back, the panel a sidebar toggle shows at the start edge, a list's bullets at the start, a paper
# plane that is sent. Not flipped: what is physical (a rotation, a speaker, a padlock, a fan), a media control (play points the way the
# film runs), a check, a clock, a logo or a letter. design/rtl.md has the reasons. Checked by `build.py --check` and by the test
# `icons::tests::mirrored_icons_are_the_ones_labels_tsv_names`.
